primitives.name: Entropy-Regularized Injury Allocation
primitives.verbatim_quote: | | `src/coach-sim/locked-projection.ts` | Routed injury-overlay reallocation through `sinkhornTargetAllocation`, so active-set shares are the column marginal of an entropy-regularised transport plan.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'P': 'transport plan matrix (dimensionless)', 'c_{ij}': 'cost matrix element (dimensionless)', 'τ': 'entropy regularization parameter (dimensionless)', 'μ': 'source distribution (dimensionless)', 'ν': 'target distribution (dimensionless)'}
primitives.assumptions: Transport plan must be doubly stochastic, cost matrix is known, entropy regularization ensures smoothness.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When τ → 0, converges to standard optimal transport; when τ → ∞, uniform distribution.
